NS/NS.py contains a bare undefined example_libraries expression and uses optimizers without importing it, blocking the entrypoint as written.
README says code and data are available upon request while the pinned tree bundles benchmark code, data and animations.
No original hardware or accelerator environment is specified.
Bundled animations document qualitative historical outputs, but immutable numerical targets or acceptance thresholds and reusable trained checkpoints are not provided.
The separate patent/noncommercial warning and CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license are preserved without legal interpretation.
notes: R2: source, exact dependency versions, benchmark inputs, mathematics, configurations, training and evaluation logic are present. Undocumented installation plus pervasive data-path mismatches and the Navier-Stokes entrypoint defect block R3/R4.
